candidate_relations.reason: Hemangiopericytoma is not leiomyosarcoma and does not preserve the reference tumor lineage; the smooth-muscle immunophenotype supports leiomyosarcoma.
Meningioma was the preoperative clinical impression, but resection showed a malignant smooth-muscle spindle-cell neoplasm rather than meningioma.
